subject: Uniswap v4-core
thesis: I conclude the v4.0.0 release-watch dataset is not verified by the pages read, so it should be treated as UNKNOWN until the tag, date, source URL, and self-test are shown. The Hugging Face publishing mechanism described in the pages is FACT, but it does not prove the Uniswap release claim.

risks: The v4.0.0 tag, date, source URL, verified rows, and logged EXIT=0 self-test are not shown in any page read, so publishing them as verified would be unsupported.
The bee-scouts check found 0 of 50 recent commits were real work, which is a weak-activity signal for the surrounding project context.
A dataset viewer page for an existing Uniswap dataset was mostly non-English string content and did not verify v4-core release data.
